# Ravi Kovind

> Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience designing, building, deploying, and maintaining production-grade applications. Specialises in full-stack, mobile (Flutter), backend, and infrastructure.

## About

Ravi Kovind is a Founding Engineer based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. He has worked across the full product lifecycle — from greenfield architecture to production deployments — building systems that serve real users at scale.

- Email: hey.ravikovind@gmail.com
- Website: https://ravikovind.github.io
- GitHub: https://github.com/ravikovind
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/ravikovind
- Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

## Experience

### Voltvave Innovations Pvt Ltd — Founding Engineer (Mar 2025 – Jul 2026)
Built Tredye, a real-time market monitoring dashboard: 12-service Kafka-based event-driven system (<50ms latency), RSI/divergence detection, multi-source news aggregation, Next.js 16 + TradingView frontend. Also built MCPVave, an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for AI agent integration.

### TingTing — Senior Flutter Engineer (Aug 2022 – Mar 2025)
Architected a 6-app Flutter ecosystem (Customer, Merchant, Rider, Admin, CRM, Notification Panel) with BLoC, adaptive server-driven UI, and go_router. Built Zoho Gofrugal ERP stock sync on GCP Cloud Run syncing 35+ stores × 12K+ products. Led full release cycles on Play Store and App Store.

### Workrush — Software Engineer (prior)
Built end-to-end hyperlocal commerce platform: 4 Flutter apps, Express.js API with 23 MongoDB schemas, geospatial store discovery, 7-stage order lifecycle with WebSocket sync, AWS infrastructure (EC2, S3, SES, CloudFront, WAF).

## Selected Projects

- [GrihaHomes](https://grihahomes.com): Agent-centric property listing platform (Bengaluru). NestJS + Prisma + PostGIS backend, Next.js + Tailwind frontend, SMS OTP auth, visit booking lifecycle, role-based access, Claude AI chat. Deployed on OCI ARM free tier.
- [Open Notifier](https://open-notifier.io): Self-hostable multi-tenant push notification platform with MCP support. AI agents send FCM push to users' phones. Node.js + Express 5 + BullMQ + Valkey + Flutter mobile app + SigNoz observability.
- [Tredye](https://tredye.com): Real-time trading dashboard. 12-service Kafka pipeline, RSI/ZigZag divergence detection, Next.js 16 + TradingView charts.
- [Bhagavad Gita](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gita): Flutter app, 40K+ downloads, 2K DAU, offline-first with Isolate-based multithreading and Hydrated BLoC.

## Open Source

- [flutter_lucide](https://pub.dev/packages/flutter_lucide): 1,666+ Lucide icons for Flutter. 4K weekly downloads, 6 platforms.
- [flutter_lucide_animated](https://pub.dev/packages/flutter_lucide_animated): Animated icon library featured in pqoqubbw/icons (6.8K GitHub stars).
